cold-storms.state: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings covering a major region were found as of 7 Nov. Met Office warnings for the UK were yellow at worst, and searches found no cold outbreak causing widespread power or gas outages in North America or Europe.
cold-storms.for_you: Check your national met service for local warnings as winter approaches.

respiratory.summary: Early flu season in the US and UK; CDC expects admissions to rise through mid-November
respiratory.state: The CDC forecasts US flu hospital admissions will keep climbing through mid-November after the season's first child death, in an early season (CDC FluView; Nature World News, 4 Nov). UKHSA reports flu rising unusually early in England (EMJ). Health systems are not reported as strained, and no WHO variant of concern had been designated as of 7 Nov.
respiratory.for_you: Eligible people can get flu and COVID-19 vaccines; follow NHS and UKHSA advice.
respiratory.rubric_hit: Unusually early flu season in a hemisphere = Watch

medicine-shortages.summary: US shortages of sterile injectables persist; no widespread rationing across major health systems
medicine-shortages.state: The FDA's shortage database still lists dozens of current shortages, mostly sterile injectables such as chemotherapy drugs (IntuitionLabs; Drugs.com). Searches on 7 Nov found no widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems, and no new UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
medicine-shortages.for_you: If a prescribed medicine is unavailable, speak to your pharmacist or GP; do not stop treatment without advice.
medicine-shortages.rubric_hit: Essential medicine shortages across systems = Watch; no widespread rationing (Alert)

exploited-vulns.summary: Three new CISA known-exploited vulnerabilities in a week, including SonicWall VPN
exploited-vulns.state: CISA added three vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue in the seven days to 6 Nov and 30 in 30 days, under the 11-a-week Watch line. The latest are a SonicWall SSL VPN flaw (6 Nov), an Apple flaw (4 Nov) and WordPress Core (3 Nov).
exploited-vulns.for_you: Keep devices and software updated; NCSC publishes guidance on patching.

aid-funding.summary: WFP cuts Gaza food aid for 500,000 people over a $450m gap; Somalia and Sudan aid also squeezed
aid-funding.state: WFP is dropping about 500,000 people in Gaza from food aid as a funding gap of about $450m deepens (Outlook India; DevelopmentAid). More than 700,000 people in Somalia lose WFP food assistance in November (Eastleigh Voice). No formal suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country had been announced as of 7 Nov.
aid-funding.for_you: No direct risk to most readers; the UN's funding appeals are listed by OCHA.
aid-funding.rubric_hit: Major ration cuts announced = Watch; no pipeline break in famine-risk country (Alert)

uk-supply-margins.summary: No NESO or National Gas margin notices in force; NESO expects adequate winter margins
uk-supply-margins.state: NESO's winter outlook expects adequate but lower electricity supply margins this winter (Drax Electric Insights). Searches on 7 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice in force since the margin call of 6 Oct (Current News).
uk-supply-margins.for_you: No action needed; NESO publishes any margin notices on its website.
